'''Sareet''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="JC8" /> within the [[Stensen sector/Legends|Stensen sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sareeta]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which was notable for its mottled pink skin and large, lidless [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Their society developed in isolation up to the [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|atomic]] age,<ref name="JC8" /> at which point, sometime between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]],<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> they encountered the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] community. The Sareeta leaders encouraged this contact by urging their youth to venture beyond their homeworld and explore the new community before returning to help develop their planet. However, not all young Sareeta were so responsible. One such youth was the reckless [[Sassan Sareeta|Sassan]], who had no interest in building up his society, instead seeking free travel on disreputable freight haulers.<ref name="JC8" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sareet was first mentioned in "[[The Yard of Opportunity]]," an article written by [[Christopher M. Olson]] for the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', which was published in [[November]] [[1995]].<ref name="JC8" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Sareet system/Legends|Sareet star system]] and the world itself in grid square I-17.<ref name="EA" />
